title: $2.86 Single Bondi Burger for Flame Rewards Members (One Burger Per Account - Free to Join) @ Oporto
body:
Deal: $2.86 Single Bondi Burger for Flame Rewards Members (One Burger Per Account - Free to Join) @ Oporto

[jv] $2.86 Single Bondi Burger @ Oporto
Followed by a huge Bondi Cigar for a pleasant finish to the night…
[coxymla] $2.86 seems very expensive for a chicken burger in 1986.
Whopper and onion rings combo was $2.95 in 1991.
[tightm8] Oporto was considered 'premium' when it first came out. Kind of like the $25 burgers you see today.
Since then, it has declined.
[Hvrd] Free regular chips when I signed up, hoping the $3 birthday bonus lasts for a few days as I set it as 12/9
[Onemoredeal] The original 1986 Bondi burger had 2 fillets and they were massive as was the burger . This isn’t that it’s not much bigger than a cheeseburger
[DingoBlue] They still have two.
This promo specifically refers to “SINGLE BONDI BURGER”.
[Onemoredeal] It’s not the legendary Bondi burger at its original price.
[dajiska] get disappointed as stores will be sold out of this deal!
[Two50rr] I remember a double bondi burger was like $3 in 1996 at Dee Why. Served all greasy in a Styrofoam container. Tasted so much better than what it is now.
